target_paper.title: Justice or Prejudice? Quantifying Biases in LLM-as-a-Judge
target_paper.repo_license: none declared (README defers to the per-row source datasets)
target_paper.original_source: Table 4 (D_FR, row GPT-4-Turbo, columns Ver. and CR_FR); RR/CR defined in Sec. 3 Metrics

generation.parameters: one user message (the '[System]' header is part of the template); temperature 0.7 (Sec. 3 Hyperparameters); max_tokens 1024 and top_p 1.0 unreported by the paper, carried over from the Tier B config; no seed parameter; 1 seed
generation.prompt_template_source: external/repos/W4403885225/Y0oMu__LLM-Judge-Bias-Dataset/promptTemplate.py evaluate_ai_responses (== evaluate_ai_responses_no_tie), the source string of Appendix F Figure 13, imported from the release rather than transcribed
generation.battery: 1500 archived calls = 500 items x 3 judgments (orig / pert / rep), item-major; 500 complete triples

results.primary_rule: unparsable or missing verdict -> item dropped, drop rate reported

mcnemar_rr_below_cr.test: exact McNemar (binomial on discordant items), H1: RR < CR

published_ordering_context.note: single live arm by decision; the ordering GPT-4o > Claude-3.5 > GPT-4-Turbo > ChatGPT is reported as context, not re-measured

results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 as the card instantiates it (0.915 inside the item-bootstrap 95% CI AND RR significantly below the same-run CR ceiling = survived; outside the CI but still below the ceiling = partial; not distinguishable from CR = dead); human double-coding pending

tierb_comparison.difference: Tier B ran 1,000 calls (orig+pert only, no CR arm) with the PDF transcription of the template (paragraph wraps joined, ~11 fewer input tokens per call); Tier A adds the unperturbed repeat and renders the repository's source string

reproducibility_frictions_observed: no evaluation code in the release: the verdict parser, the RR/CR aggregation and the treatment of an unparsable verdict are ours
item-level original verdicts are not released, so the comparison is at the aggregate RR/CR level only (0.915 of 500 = 457 or 458 items)
temperature 0.7 with no seed: the published 0.915 is itself a single noisy draw, and this re-run is one seed by decision
max_tokens and top_p are unreported; 1024 / 1.0 carried over from the Tier B config (no Tier B reply was truncated, longest 539 tokens)

the pairwise template offers no tie option, but the judge sometimes declares a tie in prose and emits no bracketed verdict; those items are dropped under the primary rule and counted as flips under the Tier B rule
the release declares no licence and points back to the per-row data_resource (ScienceQA CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, GSM8K/MATH MIT)
the verbosity file's unperturbed pairs differ from base_datasets/fact_related_dataset.json in a minority of rows and in row order, so 'the fact-related dataset' is not one fixed file in the release
